geraltPrompt: Create a standalone vertical 4:5 fantasy painting of Geralt of Rivia from The Witcher 3 video game for private fan-art card use. Geralt has tied-back white hair, a short white beard, amber cat-like eyes, his recognisable facial scar, worn dark leather and chainmail Witcher armour, and two sheathed swords on his back. He studies a contract on an old notice board in Velen, with a thoughtful weary expression and one hand resting on the board. Frame him prominently from mid-thigh upwards; the face and gesture must remain central and readable. Restrained misty rural background. Match the painting language of the two attached Kalistar style references: visible brushstrokes, painted volumes, tactile worn materials, narrative emotion, natural human anatomy. Not a photograph, not a smooth 3D render, not anime or manga. No writing, logos, border, statistics or watermark.
